metadata.description: AI-powered writing and research tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: fact-checker
plugins.changelog: Codex CLI 0.130 compatibility: --full-auto -> --sandbox workspace-write (old flag deprecated), stdin redirected to /dev/null (silences 'Reading additional input from stdin'), Codex error parser now reads structured JSONL error/turn.failed events instead of bubbling up noisy stderr (skill-load + deprecation warnings no longer masquerade as failures). Matches the spec-debate v1.5.1 fix.
plugins.description: Systematically verify factual claims using multi-LLM triage and source-grounded verification.

plugins.name: spec-debate
plugins.changelog: Added MiniMax provider (MINIMAX_API_KEY) with MiniMax-M3 flagship, routed via litellm's native minimax provider to the international endpoint (api.minimax.io); wired into the provider list, credential validation, and live discover-models. M3 accepts temperature so it runs on the standard (non-reasoning) path. Requires litellm>=1.83.0 for M3 cost-registry support. June 2026 catalog re-validated against live discover-models across OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, xAI, and MiniMax.
plugins.description: Multi-LLM adversarial spec debate. Refines PRDs and tech specs through iterative critique until all models reach consensus.

plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: Multi-LLM adversarial project review. Evaluates progress, tech stack, code quality, CI/CD, and plan drift through parallel critique from multiple AI models.

plugins.name: gtm-forge
plugins.description: Build, validate, and stress-test Go-To-Market strategies for enterprise managed services. Multi-LLM adversarial critique, vendor claim verification, competitive counter-pitches, and funding research.

plugins.name: pi-cli-skill
plugins.changelog: Reword SKILL.md to remove literal $N references in prose — slash-command processor was substituting them inside the warning text itself, mangling the docs. Plus the v0.2.0 SDK drop.
plugins.description: Pi CLI wrapper — code review / adversarial challenge / consult with session continuity. Provider-agnostic second opinion via @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent.
